subject: Next steps: secure handoff of DPIA / Art. 30 logs for Acme - evidence collection plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Timothy Shaw <tim.shaw@acmeco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: secure transfer of DPIA evidence and processing records

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As part of Acme's procurement checklist we need a secure handoff of the DPIA artifacts and the Art. 30 processing records you referenced.

Specifically we need:
- A time-limited, auditable bundle containing the Art. 30 processing activities for the Acme tenancy (last 12 months)
- A copy of the DPIA support materials you used for the initial assessment (scans of any signed approvals)
- A manifest of subprocessors with dates of onboarding/offboarding and the most recent transfer assessments

Two important constraints from our side: the bundle needs to be delivered to our external auditor (CloudTrust) via SFTP or an equivalent secure transfer; they require retained audit logs for the transfer and a brief chain-of-custody statement signed by Redwood.

Can you confirm Redwood can:
1) Produce the Art. 30 export in a machine-readable format (CSV + schema)
2) Provide a tamper-evident checksum for the archive
3) Arrange an SFTP delivery window next week (preferred window: Mon 23 Nov 10:00-14:00 PST)

Appreciate a short plan and any docs we should route to CloudTrust in advance.

Best,
Elena
VP, Privacy & Compliance
Acme Co.

[Attachment: acme_evidence_requirements_template.xlsx]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Timothy Shaw <tim.shaw@acmeco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: secure transfer of DPIA evidence and processing records

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can do this; below is the proposed approach and deliverables. Happy to sync if you want to walk through it before transfer.

What Redwood will produce:
- Art. 30 export: CSV + JSON schema + a short README describing column definitions and retention dates
- DPIA support package: PDF of the DPIA assessment report (redacted where needed), approvals log, and any signed change requests
- Subprocessor manifest: CSV with onboarding/offboarding timestamps, transfer risk classification, and last-assessment date
- Chain-of-custody statement: short PDF signed by our Privacy lead; includes hash values for each file in the archive

Security and transfer plan:
- We will create a password-protected ZIP with AES-256 encryption; generate SHA-256 checksums for each file and for the final archive.
- Delivery options: SFTP (preferred) OR Azure Blob with Shared Access Signature (time-limited link). We will record SFTP session logs and provide the delivery log as part of the handoff.
- Proposed delivery window: Tue 24 Nov 10:00-13:00 PST (adjustable).

Next steps we need from Acme:
- Confirm preferred transfer mechanism (SFTP host / user to target or we provide temporary target)
- Confirm contact at CloudTrust who will retrieve the files (name and SSH key if they want a public-key SFTP account)

I[0m'll prepare the artifacts and aim to have the bundle ready for an internal review by Fri 20 Nov.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Privacy Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: dpi_a_support_checklist_v2.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: secure transfer of DPIA evidence and processing records

Mina —

Two quick notes from the legal/compliance side before you finalize the bundle:
1) Redaction guidance: ensure PII of Redwood employees (internal HR IDs, home addresses) is removed unless strictly required. Mark any redacted fields in the README.
2) Audit rights: confirm the scope in writing — specifically whether CloudTrusts audit includes on-site access or is strictly document review. If on-site, we need to confirm account-level access controls and an escort policy.

Ill draft the chain-of-custody language and sign off on the statement. If you want, I can also provide a short cover memo framing the Art. 30 export for non-technical reviewers at Acme.

-L

Laura Bennett
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Timothy Shaw <tim.shaw@acmeco.com>, CloudTrust Auditor <auditor@cloudtrust.org>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: secure transfer of DPIA evidence and processing records

Thanks Mina and Laura — this looks good. A few clarifications from CloudTrust's checklist (copied in):
- CloudTrust will perform a document review only (no on-site) for this engagement.
- They request the Art. 30 export include the data categories mapped to processing activities (column-level mapping).
- For SFTP delivery we can provide a temporary target; I'll open a case with our security team and share credentials (or public key) by EOD Mon 23 Nov.

Tim, can your team confirm the SFTP endpoint preference?

Regards,
Elena

[Attached: CloudTrust_checklist_excerpt.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeco.com>, Timothy Shaw <tim.shaw@acmeco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, CloudTrust Auditor <auditor@cloudtrust.org>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: secure handoff of DPIA / Art. 30 logs for Acme - evidence collection plan

Elena / Tim —

Quick update: the artifacts are assembled and in staging. Contents summary:
- redwood_art30_processing_records_2026-10.csv (schema + column mapping included)
- dpi_a_support_package.pdf (DPIA report and approvals)
- subprocessor_manifest_2026-11.csv
- chain_of_custody_acme_20261120.pdf (signed by Laura Bennett)

We've produced SHA-256 checksums and will embed them in the README. I can proceed with SFTP delivery on Tue 24 Nov as discussed once you confirm the endpoint / credentials.

If Acme prefers we can also perform an encrypted upload to your Azure container and provide an SAS link; we will still produce session logs and the checksum artifact.

Action items: 
- Elena/TIm: confirm SFTP endpoint or Azure SAS by EOD Mon 23 Nov
- CloudTrust: expected retrieval window Tue 24 Nov 10:00-13:00 PST (please confirm)

Thanks — Ill hold the secure archive until we have the transfer details.

Mina Haddad
Senior Privacy Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_art30_processing_records_2026-10.zip]
